ground_truth.firms_fire_observations: acquired (local FIRMS + NASA EONET v3 Historical Wildfires, 139 months)
ground_truth.ibtracs_cyclones: acquired (NOAA IBTrACS v04r01 North Atlantic filtered to Mexico)
ground_truth.gpm_gldas: available as indicators, not independent labels
ground_truth.flood: evaluated against NOAA IBTrACS v04r01 tropical cyclone tracks in Mexico

evaluated_hazards.source: NASA FIRMS local observations + NASA EONET v3 Historical Wildfires
NOAA IBTrACS v04r01 (tropical cyclone tracks in Mexico)

skipped_hazards.reason: No independent ground-truth labels are available for hazard 'sequia'.
Catalog has zero finite values for 'tectonic_score_proxy' (insufficient sensor/SAR temporal pairs).

deployment.docker_checks: passed (config, build, PostgreSQL migrations, Redis healthcheck, /api/catalog/status/ and /api/predictions/ smoke tests)

notes: Adaptive policy uses sequential cleaning for small ALOS input and parallel cleaning only when the configured file/size thresholds are met.
Parallel cleaning is slower for the small 15-tile benchmark dataset.
GPU is slower for the tiny neural smoke workload; larger workloads require a representative benchmark.
Tectonic score remains non-evaluable because local ALOS (2011-04) and NISAR (2026-11) tiles lack co-registered temporal pairs.
